name: KubeEdge
description: CNCF graduation-level Kubernetes Native Edge Computing Framework that extends native containerized application orchestration and device management to hosts at the Edge, consisting of cloud and edge parts.

docker_support.docker_evidence: docker-compose.yaml at kubeedge/build/edge/docker-compose.yaml. On edge side, you need to install docker, mqtt and edgecore.

eval_notes: Major CNCF edge computing project. Good for edge orchestration, device management, and edge-cloud coordination evals. CNCF graduated project for real cloud-edge orchestration. CloudHub/EdgeHub architecture ideal for testing edge autonomy, device management, and cloud-edge synchronization scenarios.
